tools.name: fireprotection_begin_host_resolution_pass
tools.title: Begin host resolution pass
tools.description: Opens a read-only host-resolution pass: ceiling/floor/roof and link-instance element lists are collected once and reused for every candidate point until fireprotection_end_host_resolution_pass is called. This exists purely for performance. Without it, each candidate point rebuilt the same document-wide element lists, which is O(rooms x candidates x document) collectors on the thread that also pumps the UI - the main cause of the tool freezing. Callers MUST bracket a single read-only sweep and MUST end it before any document modification. Elements are only valid while the document is unmodified, which is why the cache is scoped to one pass rather than kept for the session.

tools.name: fireprotection_calculate_notification_appliance_layout
tools.title: Calculate notification appliance placement layout (NFPA 72)
tools.description: Runs the provisional notification appliance (strobe/speaker/speaker-strobe) placement calculation on the provided rooms. The notification rules are PROVISIONAL and catalog-independent - they use simplified audible/visible coverage heuristics rather than full NFPA 72 Chapter 18 calculations. The run and its report are flagged 'engineering review required'. Computes device locations based on room geometry, appliance type (strobe, speaker, speaker-strobe), candela rating, and dBA rating. Uses centered grid layout with spacing derived from candela coverage. Obstacle conflicts are flagged. Returns per-room results with calculated points, diagnostics, warnings, and errors. This is a read-only calculation that does not modify the Revit model. Results are NOT NFPA 72 compliant without engineering review.

tools.name: fireprotection_calculate_smoke_detector_layout
tools.title: Calculate smoke detector placement layout (NFPA 72)
tools.description: Runs the NFPA 72 Chapter 17 smoke detector placement calculation engine on the provided rooms. Computes optimal detector locations based on room geometry, detector type (spot, beam, aspirating), mount (ceiling/wall), ceiling slope, and air changes per hour. Supports both ceiling-grid-snapped (tile-centered) and free-centered orthogonal grid layouts, plus wall-mount layouts for corridors. Applies NFPA 72 spacing rules: max spacing S=30 ft (smooth/level ceilings), wall distance <= S/2 (15 ft), radial coverage <= 0.7*S (21.213 ft). High airflow (ACH > 7.5) reduces coverage area per Table 17.7.6.3.3.2. Obstacle conflicts are flagged but do not discard candidates (non-destructive). Performs post-selection NFPA 72 compliance checks (corner coverage, wall distance, obstacle notices). Returns per-room results with calculated points, diagnostics, warnings, and errors. This is a read-only calculation that does not modify the Revit model.

tools.name: fireprotection_calculate_sprinkler_layout
tools.title: Calculate sprinkler placement layout (BruteForce)
tools.description: Runs the BruteForce sprinkler placement calculation engine on the provided rooms using NFPA 13-2022 rules. The engine computes optimal sprinkler locations based on room geometry, hazard classification, ceiling type/height, obstacles, and selected sprinkler type. Supports both ceiling-grid-snapped (tile-centered) and free-centered array layouts. Handles pendent, upright, and sidewall orientations. Applies ceiling height adjustments, slope factors, and small-room rules. Obstacle conflicts are flagged but do not discard candidates (non-destructive). Returns per-room results with calculated points, diagnostics, warnings, and errors. This is a read-only calculation that does not modify the Revit model. The calculation uses provisional spacing rules (15 ft default) unless project-approved hazard placement rules are supplied.

rooms.description: Array of room input objects for calculation.

selected_family_name.description: Universal sprinkler family name for rooms without per-room override.

selected_type_name.description: Universal sprinkler type name for rooms without per-room override.

tools.name: fireprotection_check_clearance
tools.title: Check clearance/clash between element sets
tools.description: Detects hard clashes or clearance violations between two element sets (host or linked files). Uses Revit's ReferenceIntersector for accurate raycast-based clearance checks. axis='bbox' inflates setA bounding boxes by clearanceMm in all directions â€” use for omnidirectional proximity checks. axis='Z' fires a vertical ReferenceIntersector raycast from each setA element and automatically finds the nearest setB element directly below or above it; reports the actual measured clearance. Use direction='below' (ductâ†’floor below) or 'above' (ductâ†’ceiling above). IMPORTANT for axis='Z': do NOT manually fetch or enumerate setB elements first â€” just pass a category filter in setB and let the raycast locate the nearest hit automatically. clearanceMm=0 + axis='bbox' â†’ hard clash only. This is a read-only check that does not modify the model.

link_id.description: Required when source='link'. ElementId of the RevitLinkInstance.

categories.description: BuiltInCategory names, e.g. ['OST_DuctCurves', 'OST_PipeCurves']. Empty = all element types.

scope_id.description: ElementId of a spatial container (MEP Space, Room, Floor, equipment). Only elements whose centroid falls inside that element's bbox are included.

view_id.description: ElementId of a 3D view for axis=Z raycast. Uses active view if omitted.

violation_mm.description: How much the measured clearance falls short of the threshold.

tools.name: fireprotection_clear_eligibility_cache
tools.title: Clear placement eligibility cache
tools.description: Drops any cached eligibility results. Deliberately NOT called automatically before every sweep. The cache key already covers room identity, level name, hazard class, family and type, so those inputs miss the cache on their own. Call it when the DOCUMENT changes in a way the key cannot see - in practice, after loading a family. Known remaining gap: a linked-model edit, or an in-place ceiling move, is not visible to the key and can therefore serve stale results until the next family load or manual invalidation.

tools.name: fireprotection_end_host_resolution_pass
tools.title: End host resolution pass
tools.description: Ends the read-only host-resolution pass opened by fireprotection_begin_host_resolution_pass and releases cached elements. Must be called before any document modification.

collector_calls_saved.description: Number of document-wide collector invocations avoided by the cache.

tools.name: fireprotection_evaluate_notification_appliance_eligibility
tools.title: Evaluate notification appliance placement eligibility for rooms
tools.description: Performs pre-placement eligibility checks for a batch of rooms for notification appliance placement. Reuses the SAME calculation, family/level resolution, and ceiling-host logic the real run uses, but creates no elements and opens no transaction. Returns a dictionary keyed by RoomId with PlacementEligibilityResult for each room. Rooms whose eligibility cannot be decided are UNDETERMINED, never falsely blocked. The provisional notification rules mean all results should be treated as requiring engineering review. Use before placement to filter out unplaceable rooms in the UI.

tools.name: fireprotection_evaluate_smoke_detector_eligibility
tools.title: Evaluate smoke detector placement eligibility for rooms
tools.description: Performs pre-placement eligibility checks for a batch of rooms for smoke detector placement. Reuses the SAME calculation, family/level resolution, and ceiling-host logic the real run uses, but creates no elements and opens no transaction. Returns a dictionary keyed by RoomId with PlacementEligibilityResult for each room. Rooms whose eligibility cannot be decided (e.g., calculation could not run) are UNDETERMINED, never falsely blocked. Use before placement to filter out unplaceable rooms in the UI.

tools.name: fireprotection_evaluate_sprinkler_eligibility
tools.title: Evaluate sprinkler placement eligibility for a room
tools.description: Performs a deterministic pre-placement eligibility check for a single room given the currently selected sprinkler family/type and the room's actual candidate sprinkler points. The evaluation reuses the EXACT same family-resolution, strategy-selection, level-resolution, and ceiling-host logic that the actual placement uses, but performs only READ-ONLY queries â€” no transaction, no FamilyInstance creation. Returns a structured result with one of three semantic states: ELIGIBLE (at least one candidate satisfies all placement prerequisites), BLOCKED (deterministic inability to place with explicit reason), or UNDETERMINED (could not be decided due to configuration/infrastructure error). This is the single source of truth for whether a room can receive sprinklers with the current configuration. Use before placement to filter out unplaceable rooms in the UI.

room.description: RoomUiData object with room geometry, classification, and extension data.

extension_data.description: Full room data from ModelSnapshot (ceilings, obstacles, existing sprinklers, boundary, hazard, source).

candidates.description: Calculated sprinkler points from BruteForce calculation for this room.

tools.name: fireprotection_extract_lightweight_snapshot
tools.title: Extract lightweight model snapshot
tools.description: Extracts a lightweight model snapshot from the active Revit document without heavy obstacle geometry extraction. This performs fast extraction of levels, ceilings, rooms with hazard classifications, and existing sprinklers, but defers obstacle extraction until later. All geometry is normalized to host MEP coordinates. Use this when you need to launch the UI quickly or when obstacles are not immediately needed for the workflow. Returns a structured ModelSnapshot DTO with empty obstacles list, summary statistics, warnings, and errors.

export_file_path.description: Optional path to export the snapshot as JSON. If omitted, the snapshot is returned in memory only.

tools.name: fireprotection_extract_model_snapshot
tools.title: Extract full model snapshot
tools.description: Extracts a complete model snapshot from the active Revit document including all linked architectural models. This performs full data extraction: levels (host + links in host coordinates), ceilings (3D solid recursive geometry with slope classification), rooms with boundary geometry and hazard classifications, obstacles (columns, beams, walls, MEP elements), and existing sprinklers from both host and linked models. All geometry is normalized to host MEP coordinates. The operation is read-only and does not modify the model. Use this when you need the complete model data for placement calculations or analysis. The extraction can take several seconds on large models with many linked files. Returns a structured ModelSnapshot DTO with summary statistics, warnings, and errors.

export_file_path.description: Optional path to export the snapshot as JSON. If omitted, the snapshot is returned in memory only.

tools.name: fireprotection_extract_obstacles
tools.title: Extract obstacles on demand
tools.description: Extracts MEP, architectural, and structural obstacles (columns, beams, walls, ducts, pipes, cable trays, etc.) from the active Revit document and linked models, and associates them to the provided rooms. This is typically called after a lightweight snapshot when obstacle data is needed for placement calculations. All obstacle geometry is normalized to host MEP coordinates. The operation is read-only and does not modify the model. Returns a list of ObstacleData with bounding boxes and room associations.

room_ids.description: Room IDs (ElementIds as strings) to associate obstacles with. Only obstacles intersecting these rooms in XY and Z will be returned.

tools.name: fireprotection_load_catalog
tools.title: Load device catalog from Excel workbook
tools.description: Loads the device catalog from an Excel workbook (.xlsx) containing sprinkler, smoke detector, and notification appliance definitions. The workbook must have sheets named 'Sprinklers', 'SmokeDetectors', and/or 'NotificationAppliances' with required columns. The loader validates the catalog schema and returns a populated CatalogService with lookup capabilities. Throws CatalogLoadException on any IO or schema problem. Use this before running placement calculations to ensure the correct device data is available.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the Excel catalog workbook (.xlsx).

tools.name: fireprotection_place_notification_appliances
tools.title: Place notification appliances in Revit model
tools.description: Places actual Revit FamilyInstance notification appliances (strobes, speakers, speaker-strobes) in the model for every calculated point from a notification appliance calculation result. Uses the shared FireAlarmDevicePlacementCore which handles symbol/level resolution, existing-device policy, ceiling-host resolution, and transaction management. Runs inside a TransactionGroup so the entire run is a single undo entry; cancellation rolls back everything. Performs post-placement spatial validation. The provisional notification rules mean results require engineering review. Supports existing-device policies (SkipRoom, ReplaceExisting, AddAnyway). Requires the appliance family/type to be loaded in the active Revit document under OST_FireAlarmDevices. This function WRITES to the Revit model. Use with caution on production models.

tools.name: fireprotection_place_smoke_detectors
tools.title: Place smoke detectors in Revit model
tools.description: Places actual Revit FamilyInstance smoke detectors in the model for every calculated point from an NFPA 72 calculation result. Uses the shared FireAlarmDevicePlacementCore which handles symbol/level resolution, existing-device policy, ceiling-host resolution, and transaction management. Runs inside a TransactionGroup so the entire run is a single undo entry; cancellation rolls back everything. Performs post-placement spatial validation using bounding-box center Z (authoritative for work-plane families) and XY deviation checks. Supports existing-device policies (SkipRoom, ReplaceExisting, AddAnyway). Requires the detector family/type to be loaded in the active Revit document under OST_FireAlarmDevices. This function WRITES to the Revit model and cannot be fully previewed without a dry-run mode. Use with caution on production models.

items.description: Array of DeviceRoomInputItem objects matching the calculation input.

tools.name: fireprotection_place_sprinklers
tools.title: Place sprinklers in Revit model
tools.description: Places actual Revit FamilyInstance sprinklers in the model for every calculated point from a BruteForce calculation result. Resolves the selected FamilySymbol from the active document, activates it, and creates instances using the correct placement overload for the family's host behavior (FaceBased, WorkPlaneBased, OneLevelBased, or WallSidewall). Runs inside a TransactionGroup so the entire run is a single undo entry; cancellation rolls back everything. Performs post-placement spatial validation: each placed instance's actual location is compared to the requested point, and deviations beyond tolerance are flagged as PLACED_BUT_INVALID. Supports existing-device policies (SkipRoom, ReplaceExisting, AddAnyway). Requires the sprinkler family/type to be loaded in the active Revit document. This function WRITES to the Revit model and cannot be fully previewed without a dry-run mode (not currently implemented in the backend). Use with caution on production models.

selected_family_name.description: Revit family name of the sprinkler to place.

selected_type_name.description: Revit type name of the sprinkler to place.

existing_device_policy.description: What to do with rooms that already contain sprinklers.

ignore_obstacles.description: When true, places sprinklers at candidate locations regardless of obstacle conflicts.

tools.name: fireprotection_probe_missing_families
tools.title: Probe for missing sprinkler families
tools.description: Read-only probe that lists (Room, Family, Type) entries whose chosen family/type is not loadable in the current Revit model. Returns an empty list when every row's family is available. No elements are created. This is useful before running a placement to ensure all required families are loaded. The probe checks against the OST_Sprinklers category in the active document.

tools.name: fireprotection_query_catalog_notification_appliances
tools.title: Query notification appliance catalog entries
tools.description: Queries the loaded notification appliance catalog for families, types, and their properties. Returns all notification appliance families, or types for a specific family, or full entries for a family. Use this to populate UI dropdowns or to look up appliance specifications (appliance type, candela rating, dBA rating) before running calculations.

family_name.description: Optional family name to filter by. If omitted, returns all families.

include_entries.description: If true and family_name is provided, returns full entries with all properties.

tools.name: fireprotection_query_catalog_smoke_detectors
tools.title: Query smoke detector catalog entries
tools.description: Queries the loaded smoke detector catalog for families, types, and their properties. Returns all smoke detector families, or types for a specific family, or full entries for a family. Use this to populate UI dropdowns or to look up detector specifications (detector type, mount, ceiling slope) before running calculations.

family_name.description: Optional family name to filter by. If omitted, returns all families.

include_entries.description: If true and family_name is provided, returns full entries with all properties.

tools.name: fireprotection_query_catalog_sprinklers
tools.title: Query sprinkler catalog entries
tools.description: Queries the loaded sprinkler catalog for families, types, and their properties. Returns all sprinkler families, or types for a specific family, or full entries for a family. Use this to populate UI dropdowns or to look up sprinkler specifications (K-factor, coverage area, spacing, temperature rating, etc.) before running calculations.

family_name.description: Optional family name to filter by. If omitted, returns all families.

include_entries.description: If true and family_name is provided, returns full entries with all properties (KFactor, MaxCoverageAreaSqFt, MaxSpacingFt, etc.).

tools.name: fireprotection_recipe_clash_review
tools.title: Run coordination clash review recipe
tools.description: WORKFLOW RECIPE (read-only): runs a coordination clash sweep across multiple element-set pairs (host vs host, or host vs LINKED RVT) and returns a consolidated, prioritized clash report â€” hard clashes first, then clearance violations by smallest gap, counted per pair. Each pair is a check_clearance input; for links set setB.source='link' + linkId (from revit_get_linked_files). Composes check_clearance internally. Use this for a comprehensive coordination review across multiple systems.

pairs.description: Coordination matrix: each entry is a labelled check_clearance pair.

label.description: Human label for this pair, e.g. 'Ducts Ã— Struct link'.

tools.name: fireprotection_recipe_model_health_triage
tools.title: Run model health triage recipe
tools.description: WORKFLOW RECIPE (read-only): runs a model-health scan and returns a prioritized, actionable triage list â€” each issue with its severity and a recommended fix. Composes get_model_health internally; use this instead of get_model_health when you want guidance, not raw metrics. Checks warnings, file size, imported vs linked CAD, in-place families, model/detail groups, views not on sheets, element counts by category, and complexity counts. Returns a scorecard with a letter grade (A-F), a 0-100 score, and flagged issues with recommended fixes.

deep.description: Include the purge scan (Document.GetUnusedElements). Slower on large models.
